title: Google Ads AI Knowledge Base — Chunk Metadata Schema
description: Defines the required and optional metadata fields for every knowledge base chunk used in RAG retrieval.

id.description: Unique identifier for this chunk. Format: <policy_id>-<sequence>. Example: ADS-EDT-001-C1

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for the parent policy. Used for traceability and patch targeting.

title.description: Short, descriptive label for this chunk. Used in retrieval result previews.

content.description: The pruned, token-optimized policy text for this chunk. No conversational filler. Dense and precise.

content_type.description: The type of content this chunk represents.

product_area.description: Which Google Ads product areas this chunk applies to.

policy_category.description: The top-level policy category this chunk belongs to.

enforcement_action.description: The enforcement outcome when this rule is violated.

intent_match.description: User intent IDs that should trigger retrieval of this chunk.

trigger_condition.description: The specific advertiser situation that makes this chunk relevant.

routing.description: The recommended action after this chunk is retrieved and used.

audience.description: The primary audience for this chunk.

complexity.description: How technically complex this chunk is for the target audience.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date when this chunk was last reviewed or updated. Critical for staleness detection.

version.description: Incremented each time the chunk content is meaningfully changed.

tokens_approx.description: Approximate token count of the content field. Used for RAG budget management.

confidence_tier.description: How reliably this chunk answers its tagged intents. Set by the knowledge engineer after review.

related_chunks.description: IDs of other chunks that are semantically related. Used to build retrieval chains.

source_url.description: The canonical URL of the source policy page.
